description: Source code for 'pong-clock-no-flicker.c', a C program implementing a pong-based clock using X11 graphics, with functions for drawing time, game elements, and handling display updates.

methods.name: get_time
methods.description: Retrieves current local time (hour, minute, second).

methods.name: draw_rect
methods.description: Draws a filled rectangle on the X11 display.

methods.name: draw_field
methods.description: Draws the pong field with boundary lines and center dashed line.

methods.name: draw_digit
methods.description: Draws a digit using rectangle segments for the clock display.

methods.name: draw_time
methods.description: Draws current time as digits on the display.

methods.name: draw_bat_and_ball
methods.description: Draws the pong ball and bats on the display.

methods.name: update_state
methods.description: Updates the game state, including ball movement and bat positions based on time.

methods.name: draw_frame
methods.description: Updates game state and renders a complete frame.
